name: gpu-time
title: Natural-language times
description: Dates, times and recurrences written in English, parsed by gpu-time (a ~50 KB model, CPU by default, loaded on first use): parseTime resolves occurrences, RRULEs and the recognised spans; formatOccurrence, describeRecurrence and timeTextSegments turn the result into text. useTimeParse is the debounced React side NaturalTimeInput uses.
